summary: Galmed Pharmaceuticals Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders, convened on September 2, 2026, was adjourned for one day due to lack of quorum; the meeting will reconvene on September 3, 2026 at the same time and place. This is a routine procedural notice regarding a shareholder meeting, not a special situation such as a merger, tender offer, or activism. The filing is incorporated by reference into existing registration statements. There are no deal terms, premiums, or strategic actions disclosed. Watch for future filings regarding meeting results, but no unusual event is indicated.
